Soft-Side-Table-3D download, Textures/ (black colours, grey linoleum, oak and smoked oak grain). Calibrated to Muuto's packshots (SOSIT48R1/41R1, 2026-10-26) under a white-dome studio that reproduces Muuto's Cylindo packshots: the bases from the column, the tops from the top face with the grey linoleum as the reference. The oak top is paler and less yellow than the download's texture; the Orange top is lighter and yellower than the Orange base (as in the download), the Beige Green top slightly darker than its base.
note: Every top and base is sold in every size; the price depends on the size and the top. No white base is sold in any Muuto market (bases: 01 Black, 02 Grey, 03 Beige Green, 04 Orange). Muuto's materials text also mentions an Off-white linoleum top, which its configurator no longer offers.

groups.note: Muuto sells four base colours for every size (Black, Grey, Beige Green, Orange) and no white; Grey, the palest, is the default.
